description:
15 International Students Visit Palghar under International Youth Exchange Programme

Date: 20 September 2026

As part of Rotary’s International Youth Exchange Programme, 16 young students from the USA, Tanzania, Kenya and Nepal visited Palghar for three days during their India tour. The programme aims to provide young participants with an opportunity to understand and experience the educational, social, cultural and developmental aspects of different countries.

During their stay in Palghar, the students visited several places of interest, including Shirgaon Fort and Beach, Kelva Beach and Govardhan Eco Village.

They also visited the Rotary Innovative Laboratory at Jeevan Vikas School, Bliss Pharmaceuticals, the Skill Centre and Wada, where they were introduced to various initiatives and facilities aimed at empowering people in rural areas through education, technology, employment-oriented skills and opportunities to improve their quality of life.

The Palghar visit was efficiently coordinated and organised by District Secretary Rtn. Amit R. Patil, Rtn. Kaushal Patel and Secretary Rtn. Amit A. Patil.

During the farewell programme held at Niwant Resort, Kelva, the international students shared their experiences. They said that the visit gave them an opportunity to learn closely about local fishing practices, betel-leaf cultivation, paddy farming and indigenous forest vegetables. They also gained new insights into 3D printing, modern manufacturing and the rich cultural heritage of the region.

The students expressed that the warm hospitality of their hosts and the natural beauty of Palghar would remain cherished memories for them throughout their lives.

President of Rotary Club of Palghar Rtn. Bhooshan Save, along with Rtn. Milind Patil, Rtn. Jayesh Avhad, Rtn. Kalpesh Patil, Rtn. Nalin Shah, Rtn. Hanif Dhanani, Rtn. Upen Verma and all members of the Rotary Club of Palghar, extended warm hospitality and made the international guests feel at home throughout their visit.
